name: Simplifry | Vegan Cloud Kitchen
address: 16/1, Palmgrove Rd, Xavier Layout, Victoria Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560047, India
reviews: What an adventure it was searching for a vegan restaurant when we stumbled upon the delightful Kailasa Arvind, an enterprising entrepreneur running a cloud kitchen. The food was absolutely amazing, with top-notch quality and generous portions. Highly recommended!

The food here is delicious! Sahana and her team are wonderful!

This is a kitchen not a restaurant. You cannot dine in.

They do have a single table in the kitchen for two people, which they let people use if they're comfortable sitting in the kitchen. Order from Zomato or similar.

I had a tofu/rice dish with a chocolate banana cake and lassi. I love that they take standard Indian dishes and make them vegan without compromising on the flavour.

I absolutely love the creative and delicious offerings from Simplifry! Their whole wheat broccoli filled momos are a delightful twist on the classic, with a perfect balance of flavor and health. The chocolate peanut butter cake (vegan) is pure decadence—rich, moist, and with just the right amount of sweetness. The Reese cookies are a fun treat, perfectly chewy and indulgent.

The vegan curd is a game-changer, with a smooth texture and great taste, making it a fantastic dairy alternative. I’m also a huge fan of their vegan walnut brownie—fudgy, nutty, and oh-so-satisfying!

A special mention to the vegan chocolate mousse made with coconut milk, which was once my absolute favorite. It had the perfect balance of creamy richness and chocolatey goodness. It's a shame it's discontinued, but I truly hope it makes a comeback soon!

The non-alcoholic vegan plum cake from Simplifry is an absolute delight! It's packed with rich, fruity flavors and just the right amount of natural sweetness, making it perfect for the festive season or any special occasion. The texture is wonderfully moist, with a great balance of nuts and dried fruits that give it a satisfying bite.

What truly stands out is how the cake captures the essence of a traditional plum cake without the use of alcohol or animal products—proving that indulgence can be wholesome and inclusive. Whether you're vegan or just looking for a healthier treat, this cake is a must-try. Simplifry has truly perfected this festive favorite!

Simplifry continues to impress with its innovative, wholesome, and delicious menu. Highly recommended for anyone seeking tasty plant-based treats!

Thank you for your service Aravind Kailasa!
Doesn't matter if it's a cloud kitchen , one of the best vegan dishes and desserts available here ! Do not miss out ! , their kitchen is very clean !

I’ve had the pleasure of enjoying Simplifry’s vegan food at multiple events, including birthday parties and other special occasions, and they never disappoint. The food is always fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented. Their commitment to quality and taste is evident in every bite.

The team at Simplifry which is led by Kailasa and Sahana, are professional, friendly, and they always go the extra mile to ensure everything is perfect. They are reliable and have consistently delivered exceptional service, making my events truly memorable.

If you’re looking for top-notch vegan/vegetarian catering, look no further than Simplifry. Highly recommended!

name: The Rasoiya Street
address: The Rasoiya Street, First Floor, Garden of Eden by UKN, A102, Whitefield Main Rd, behind Fab India, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066, India
reviews:
Top notch interiors, delicious food with less oil and spices, menu is full of variety ( you ask for it, they have it) and amazing staff.

We went straight to main course and ordered veg kofta, double dal tadka and lachha parathas for breads. Both curries were very tasty, light on stomach and sufficient quantity. Ambience was excellent.

Enough space for parking in basement through entry from c block.

You need multiple visits if you want to taste different things as the menu is very vast. The story behind the restaurant success is inspiring and worth a read.

Only downside was laccha parathas which had white flour mixed in big quantity which gave sweeter taste and stole the essence of parathas. Will be five star for me if they improve on this one thing.

Rest, everything felt great and we will surely go back here to try another veg dishes. A place heaven and saviour for veg lovers.

Edit 1: We had dahi k sholey, Khow suey and mix kulcha in next visit. Both dahi k sholey and khow suey was delicious but mixed kulcha was very sweet as it had beans and carrot as stuffing which didn’t go well in taste.

This is the best pure veg restaurant that recently I have come across. I visited Whitefield branch, very good ambience, great hospitality and service The great sizzlers festival is going on at very affordable prices with mocktails. Just love the food taste best place to friends and family to visit great spacious ambience is very good. Lively highly recommended

Had a pretty good lunch with family at Rasoiya street whitefield.
Starters were good in taste and presentation.
Main course was also good in taste and quantity.
I would recommend Indian food more than Chinese ones.
Sunday was crowded and I would suggest booking table in advance.
Atmosphere is good but once crowded you will have difficulty hearing people at your table.

Entry street to Resturant is tight. Building has a common parking and they should add message board for the same. Street parking can be challenging.

Recently, I visited The Rasoiya Street in Whitefield. I went there with very little expectations but I was amazed at the overall experience. First things first, the place looks great with very rich ambience and bright. It has the fine dine look to it. The place can accomodate approximately 50 members at a time. Since they were running the great sizzler festival, we thought we would try them and we thoroughly enjoyed the food here. The service staff were very knowledgeable and knew their menu and dishes quite well so they were always available when needed. If you are a vegetarian, this is a must visit place for sure.
Taste wise its Very good. Tried this veg restaurant on valentine's day. Its beautifully decorated. Taste is also so good... portions are very big. Loved the experience

name: White Garden - Vegetarian Artisan Kitchen
address: 425, 2nd Block, 7th Main, 80, ft. Road, HRBR Layout 2nd Block, HRBR Layout, Kalyan Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560043, India
reviews: Fantastic vegetarian restaurant offering tasty food options from pizzas to noodles to lasagna to dumplings and everything else. The desserts   and the mocktails are amazing, too. This is a relatively expensive place, but worth it. Place is clean, the staff is attentive, valet parking available.

Nice presentation, good taste.
Have to book the table if you want to go on a weekend.
Quick service  though.

Liked the starters a lot,an international appearance to Desi food.
All in all good place.

Amazing vegetarian classy restuarant. Loved the ambience, service and food. There are lot of vegetarian and jain options available. The quantity is actually not proportional to the price and compared to normal portion in restaurants but can be shared with 2 people. The food and service is worth the price anyways. i really loved the popcorn flavoured drink which was totally new and variety.

Had a great experience in white garden. The food was a treat to tummy especially desserts , cheese cake. White garden is an excellent spot for anyone who loves vegetarian cuisine with  morden twist. I can't wait to visit again

I recently enjoyed a delightful lunch at White Garden, and it was truly an unforgettable experience! From the moment I arrived, I was captivated by the serene and picturesque ambiance. The lush greenery and elegant decor created a perfect escape—ideal for a relaxed midday meal.

The menu offered a wonderful array of options, and every dish I tried was an absolute delight. The [specific dish you tried] stood out with its rich flavors and impeccable presentation. Each bite was a testament to the chef's skill and attention to detail.

The staff were exceptional—attentive, courteous, and genuinely invested in ensuring every guest felt special. The service was prompt without feeling rushed, allowing me to savor every moment of my lunch.

What truly set White Garden apart was its ability to combine great food, impeccable service, and a tranquil atmosphere. Whether you're looking for a peaceful retreat or a sophisticated dining spot, this is the place to be. I can’t wait to return and explore more of their incredible menu.

name: Go Native Whitefield
address: No 36 Whitefield Main Rd Dyavasandra Industrial Area, near Airbus, Garudachar Palya, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048, India
reviews:
Visited Go Native and had a wonderful dining experience! The ambience was pleasant and inviting, paired with exceptional service by Bhola and Ujwal, who took great care of us throughout the evening.

We tried:
•	Paneer Buddha Bowl: Fresh, flavorful, and satisfying.
•	Tandoori Platter: A delightful mix with perfectly cooked items.
•	Averekai Chickpeas Bhel: Unique and packed with delicious flavors.

To top it off, we had the Jaggery Flavored Rasgulla—a unique twist on the classic dessert that was absolutely yum.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for fresh ingredients, innovative dishes, and a warm atmosphere!

Had an amazing time at Go Native! It had been on my list for a while, and I’m so glad I finally made it here. The ambience is raw, earthy, and beautifully designed—it truly feels like reconnecting with nature. The food was fresh, flavorful, and thoughtfully prepared. Special thanks to Roshan for serving us with such warmth and ensuring we had a great experience. Can’t wait to visit again!

I celebrated my birthday here with my family and it was a wonderful experience. The food was flavourful and healthy. Atmosphere is peaceful. Absolutely loved it. Cherry on top was the extremely sweet and attentive staff. Thank you Go Native, my go to place in Whitefield.

Went to the resturant for celebrating a special occasion. we were delighted with the peaceful ambience, creative menu and vibrant food. Will definitely go there again and try out other items from the menu. In the fast paced world where we see appeasing fast food all around this is fresh take on making best from farm produce and creating delicacies. Has vegan options too.

Tandoori platter- excellent, unique tastes, highly recommend especially mushroom and aloo were mind blowing.

Zucchini zoodles creamy cashew sauce- it really feels like noodles. Very good

Veg meat pizza- wouldn’t recommend. Curry leaf on a pizza… one can imagine.

Overall vibe is excellent, can window shop or shop outside in the store while the foods getting ready.

Great place to spend an evening.

name: PIK N GO | Authentic Veg Restaurant in Whitefield
address: Chikka Banahalli Rd, Whitefield - Hoskote Rd, Sai Gardens, Kadugodi, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560067, India
reviews: “The variety of dishes here is impressive! I tried the gongura rice and pulihora with pure ghee, and both were outstanding. The flavors were authentic, and the portions were generous. The service was friendly and attentive. Definitely one of the best South Indian restaurants I’ve visited!”

Must try -
Ghee Upma Pesarattu - Soft and thin - stuffing inside is also great

Gongura Aloo Bonda - Stuffing inside is unique - spicy and tangy with soft potato pieces.

Tried -
Ghee Podi Idli - soft idlis with Podi on top
Ghee Paddu

Complimentary-
Cup Idli - special stuffing on top with cashew pieces

Dahi Vada - tasted sweet(not a great fan of sweet dahi vada)

All the items were provided with chutneys😋(Coconut, Groundnut, Red one - Tomato and chilli - I guess😬) which have great taste. Additional quantity of chutneys served when asked.

Afridi and Bikas provided good service - helpful,quick and polite.

Pleasant place - great lawn

Lots of free parking available inside the main restaurant.

I had the pleasure of visiting PIK N GO today, and I must say, it was a fantastic experience from start to finish. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, with a great blend of comfort and style that made me feel right at home.

The service was exceptional – the staff was friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable about the menu, offering great recommendations. As for the food, it exceeded my expectations. I tried the Ragi Dosa, Pulihora & Kara bath and it was absolutely delicious, with fresh ingredients and perfectly balanced flavors.

Overall, PIK N GO is a place I would highly recommend to anyone looking for a great dining experience. I can’t wait to return!

Very good. The food is freshly prepared and delicious. The atmosphere is pleasant. Look and feel- hygiene. Kid friendly, A couple of rabbits are roaming freely in the garden.
Had gongura rice and veg biryani. Very much satisfied with the taste and quality of food.
A quaint little place with amazing food. A small menu but everything on it is fabulous. Plenty of parking and a whole lot of greenery. Definitely worth the visit

name: Element3 - Whitefield Sattvik Vegetarian, Jain & Vegan
address: 2nd Floor, Varthur Main Rd, opposite Miraya Rose, Patel Narayanswamy Layout, Siddapura, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066, India
reviews: Well i went for dinner yesterday which cost me around 1k however the taste was really not good.. for honey chilly potato they had pour tomato sause on french fries.. my stomach got upset…  don’t ever try noodles thr cz u ll get some diffrent smell in it..

This a pure Jain/Satvik Veg Restaurant.

Went for the first time due to some misunderstanding of the menu however it was nice. It was my first satvik Food experience.

There are several places in Bangalore that call themselves Sattvik, but they have always turned out bland and not fresh. I went here with our corporate group and the food was extremely fresh and tasty. I have revisited this place atleast three since then. Not once I was disappointed. Sometimes the food came a little late, but never so late that it became unbearable. Insist and ask the waiter for special dishes.

As a non vegetarian, this was an eye opening experience for me, that vegetarian food can be this good in taste!! The quality of the ingredients, dishes and ambience is something to always look forward to with my friends. I would recommend the place for anyone going for vegetarian satvik and vegan food, others will also definitely enjoy the experience.

I had vegetable pakoda here. It was too mild in taste and very bland. The accompanying chutney was also very bland and had no taste at all. After this, I had Tandoori roti and subji. These were very good and had nice flavours. The place is too small and lacked a bit of ambience. May not be a go to place for large family n group of friends. They have a paper with puzzles as a table mat to kill time while waiting for order to be served.

name: Vegan Vogue
address: #34, 80 Feet Rd, Hal, HAL 3rd Stage, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560075, India
reviews: Vegan Vogue offers a unique take on plant-based dining. I had the spinach onion ravioli and the chocolate mousse cake. The flavors were mild—some might find them bland—but I still enjoyed the meal. The texture of the ravioli was smooth, and the mousse was rich yet light. If you prefer bolder flavors, they do have spicy options on the menu. Overall, it’s a good spot for those looking for a creative but subtle vegan experience. And the staff was very friendly 😇
The food was good and tasted as clean as restaurant food goes. I had the tofu steak and a starter made with cornmeal and mushroom. I'd want to try other dishes the next time I'm back.

Went after seeing high rating online but it couldn’t meet the expectations I had from a new vegan place. I expected for more creativity and experiment with food and vegan ingredients. Pizza was ok but couldn’t keep itself together from falling apart, mac and cheese was very bland and we were told it’s a kids recipe later which was nowhere specified. Vegan food and food places have huge scope of being effortlessly innovative and refreshing imo which I couldn’t feel here.

SUGGESTION: Please replace dozens of small plastic packets of sauces and seasonings with recyclable glass bottled to become more sustainable. It broke my heart to have to use them.

Good atmosphere. Had veg kadai and apple tart here. Good fresh food. The servers were also very cordial. There is construction going on inside the restaurant.   The restaurant has a very still and nostalgic old vibe.

The service at vegan vogue is excellent. The staff is polite and attentive. I had tried sticky noodles which was homemade and agatogo with some freshly prepared juices. I visited vegan vogue with my colleagues. And I would highly recommend my fellow beings to visit this place.

name: Element3 - Indiranagar Sattvik Vegetarian, Jain & Vegan Restaurant
address: 462, Shri Krishna Temple Rd, Indira Nagar 1st Stage, Stage 1, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038, India
reviews:
One of the best vegetarian places in banglore. All their menu is Jain (no onion/no garlic), if you wish to avoid any other veggies like potato/carrot just double check with waiters before ordering.
The service is good, its situated in the first floor. They have lot of vegetarian options and offers varieties of drink too!

Loved this amazing pure vegetarian Satvik restaurant in Indiranagar , everything on their menu is made without the use of any onions , garlic and mushrooms .

Must try - Thai cigar rolls , Afghani Chaaps , Dahi ke kebabs and veg dum biryani .

Elements 3 at Indiranagar is truly a gem! The food here is absolutely amazing—delicious, hygienic, and bursting with flavors. It’s a haven for those seeking authentic vegetarian and Satvic cuisine.

The ambiance is just perfect with peaceful vibes and soothing music that elevates the dining experience. It’s not just about the food but the whole atmosphere that makes you feel at ease.

The founder is incredibly kind and welcoming, which adds a personal touch to the experience. This is hands down one of the best restaurants I’ve ever visited in Bangalore. If you’re looking for top-notch vegetarian food, Elements 3 is a must-visit. Highly recommended!

Element3 in Indiranagar is a refreshing spot for those looking to experience high-quality sattvik, Jain, and vegan cuisine. The menu is thoughtfully crafted to align with Ayurvedic principles, emphasizing ingredients that promote health and balance. They offer an impressive range of dishes, from flavorful North Indian thalis to light, inventive salads, and globally inspired vegan options. The food is mild yet satisfying, focusing on natural flavors rather than heavy spices, making it an excellent choice for diners who prefer a gentle, nourishing meal.

The ambiance is serene, with a minimalist and earthy decor that sets a calm, inviting atmosphere. Service is attentive and respectful, aligning well with the overall ethos of conscious dining. Prices are reasonable for the quality, and the restaurant’s dedication to dietary needs is clear. Element3 is ideal for those seeking a mindful, vegetarian-friendly dining experience without compromising on taste or creativity.

One of best vegetarian restaurants. The ambience was nice and filled nice painting around the place. They had vegan options too. The servers were nice and helped us with order of our choice. Their desserts were amazing and must try after the meal.

name: Sattvam Whitefield
address: 3rd Floor, 138/139, ITPL Main Road, opp Decathlon, Adjacent to Metro Wholesale, Garudachar Palya, Mahadevpura, Bangalore, Karnataka 560048, Garudachar Palya, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka +91 63641 50001, India
reviews:
Had lunch with my mom. Had a good Satvik lunch experience.
Loved the curd rice in the miniature bucket ..

(Pasta sauce tasted bad must have been old or veggies must be old) take care of the same
Pan should have much better.
Note to fellow customers :- Pizza pasta rotis will be served hot on table or hot if asked

The hotel is opp to decathlon and to the main road. Not difficult to find. It has parking service. Wash rooms are available. We visited on weekend and tables were quiet occupied. Prefer reservation. This is jain kind of cuisine. It has nice ambience with puri Jagannath designs around. Its a buffet. Initial platter they serve at the table where paneer was soft, cutlet was good. Momo was soft. Soup had tomato soup. Next is buffet salad included carrot, corn, cucumber, tomato. chats included dahi ballah was very good, pani puri was ok, dhokla was very soft. It has a separate chatvala providing bhel puri, dahipuri and others. main course with biryani, baby corn palak, beetroot, sattvic biryani was good. Daal and rice was ok. Puliogare, lemon rice was provided in mini cookers which were tasty. Curd rice in mini bucket was good. Roasted papad was available. Pasta, pizza was provided. Maalpua was good. Fruits included watermelon, pappaya. Hakka noodles with sauce was available.
Dessert has a large section velvet cales, rainbow cake, orange cake, cup cakes. Icecream had four flavours and butterscotch was very tasty. They had melted chocolate for topping.
Everything is a must try.
Good for pure veggies.
Let me know for any questions
Please like if this was helpful.

Sattvam is good for jain and veg food(with out onions and garlic) buffet meals. Considering office team lunch, this might be worth during week days for 850rs. Starters are less and some food might be salty and plain. The soup was salty. But the desserts, fruit and ice cream were good. Suggest you start from 12 during weekdays and avoid weekends as this will be rushed and you might not get good food and seat also. Pizza and pasta live counters are not so good. I suggest to taste first and then eat only what is good that day. Overall only 70% items are good and suggest you all for only one time visit!! BTW, I didn't like soda for 120rs here.

Sattvam Whitefield, a pure veg food place with no onion or garlic involved. if you're Jain looking for a none of garlic or onion, this place might be suited to you. Parking is out side, opposite to decathlon. It's on 3rd floor in the building. Ample of seating space. Nice cutlery, decent service.

Now coming to food, some items were excellent, while some were avg and some didn't really had much of taste. It's a buffet with 980₹ on weekend and 850₹ weekdays.

1. Starters had decent options which you will be served on table. Paneer tikka, seek kebab, spring roll etc. Loved it. Tasty. 4/5⭐

2. Main course was excellent in my opinion. I really liked each gravy whether it was paneer, matar malai, dal makhani, dal fry, kofta, raita etc. Hot tandoori roti and different varieties of rice. Biryani not so good. 5/5⭐

3. Chats and other items were average or not so good. Pizza and pasta were cold and total waste. Pani puri was avg. Although I couldn't try all the items, still 2/5⭐ Exception with Dahi Vada or Dahi Bhalla which was genuinely good.

4. Desert again so so. Different varieties of pastry cakes and rasmalai, gazar halwa etc. 3/5⭐

Overall with the experience and price having so many different varieties of food items at one place, I would rate it 4/5 ⭐
If you're Jain or someone who prefers pure veg restaurant with no onion garlic. This could be the place.

Should you visit? I think Yes. Worth a try and I haven't seen any other place serving this kind of buffet at this price point.

Entire restaurant menu is jain food( no garlic no onion) even though food tastes good
U can have buffet which cost you 850(weekdays) excluding taxes  & 950(weekends& public holidays)
Starters and main course is little less but deserts u can find huge options
Even u can find buffet takeaway as well
Vallet parking is available

name: Punjab Beat
address: 4th floor, Punjab Beat, Sree Rama complex, Whitefield - Hoskote Rd, above ICICI bank, Seegehalli, Krishnarajapuram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560067, India
reviews:
I ordered a "mini punjabi thali" that included tandoori roti (2 pcs), steamed rice, salad, gulab jamun( 1 pc ), Chole, paneer gravy, and buttermilk.

Review:

Tandoori roti: Superb

Chole: Too good

Gulab jamun: Nice

Buttermilk: Good

Paneer gravy: Average

Rice: Not cooked properly

Portion size: Good

very tasty and nicely cooked good
Authentic Taste
Very soft paneer which they said they make in house
Soya chap is also tasty

All the items which we ordered were satisfactory or above our expectations

Seating capacity is not very big but sufficient.

Interiors are also pleasant

5-Star Review for Hotel Punjab Beat
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Hotel Punjab Beat and was thoroughly impressed!

The staff provided cordial and attentive service, making our experience truly memorable.

The ambiance was elegant, modern and inviting, setting the tone for a wonderful meal.

Ordering was seamless via QR code, and dishes arrived promptly.

The standout starters:
1. Stuffed Paneer Kabab: Succulent, flavorful and expertly prepared.
2. Baby Corn Amritsari: Crispy, spicy and utterly delicious.

Hotel Punjab Beat is on the 4th Floor, has exceeded our expectations. I highly recommend and look forward to returning.

Don't miss this hidden gem! Perfect for special occasions or casual gatherings.

Recently visited Punjab Beat with family and relatives. It's a pure vegetarian Punjabi style restaurant. Ambience is pretty cool, cozy and appealing. Though I didn't reserve the table, there was no waiting and got table as soon as I reached.

Ordered Roasted masala papad, it tasted good and garnished with sev as well on the top. The size of the papad was small considering the price and I had to order one more.

In starters ordered Mushroom Judwa which is great and yummy, Amritsari Baby corn was not crispy and it was ok ok.

Tasted Chatakdaar Paneer in main course with Stuffed Parantha, Amritsari Kulcha and Butter rotis. All were decent and good. Ended dinner with Subz Mataka Biryani and Mango Lassi. Overall I had a decent and nice experience.

Recommend this place if you are looking for pure vegetarian restaurant. Service is quick as well. Pay via zomato to get 15% discount if you have zomato gold.

This place located in Whitefield, on 4th floor, just has Nice ambience.
Staff  here is not Welcoming, just rude behaviour, service provided is worst.
The table given to us , Sofa and table was not cleaned properly. Staff switched off light above our table while I was eating and then gave us the bill even before we asked for it, chasing us out from restaurant. People were at other tables also , simply talking and they didn't ask them to leave. Staff has No manners. Third class behaviour.
We kept asking for water, and glasses. Staff told us glasses is not available.
Coming  to food, Food here  is not great. Not up to the mark. Not much food options here.
We ordered tomato soup, which was bad. Bread basket had all type of roti. Laacha parantha ,Roti , misi roti , naan , were half uncooked and turned into rubber which was hard to chew. Didn't feel like eating, just spoilt our mood.
Chatakdar paneer subzi was okay,a bit spicy,  methi malai matar was green colour, weird taste,not good. Lahori paneer also had same green colour gravy. Looks like they have one gravy with green colour,which is added in all subzi.  Did not enjoy the food here.

Overall NOT WORTH VISITING this place!!!! I DON'T RECOMMEND.
Staff Behaviour and food really matters in a restaurant. Not just ambience!!!
Average food , zero customer satisfaction.
Restaurant should reconsider & change their menu, and  staff .
